desc: Precompute a cost matrix where cost[i][j] is the number of increments needed to make nums[i] a multiple of target[j].
Precompute for each nums element i and each bitmask mask (representing a subset of targets), the cost to satisfy all targets in mask using only nums[i], which is the max of cost[i][j] for j in mask.
Use DP with bitmask: dp[mask] represents the minimum cost to satisfy the set of targets indicated by mask. Initialize dp[0] = 0 and others to infinity.
For each mask from 1 to 2^k - 1, iterate over all submasks s of mask (non-empty), and for each nums element i, update dp[mask] = min(dp[mask], dp[mask ^ s] + cost_per_nums[i][s]).
